blocks.h2: Reasons to Get a Sewer Camera Inspection in Mokena
blocks.intro: Most calls start with one of these:

tiles.body: A standard home inspection doesn't look inside the sewer line. A camera does.
Find out whether it's roots, a sag or a broken joint.
Check the main and the under-floor drains before the new floor goes down.
Find out whether the backup came from your line or an overloaded sewer.

blocks.h2: What We Find in Mokena Sewer Lines
blocks.intro: With most homes built in the 1990s and 2000s, Mokena footage tends to look the same.

items.body: The most common finding: a low spot where water and paper sit.

items.h3: Roots at One or Two Joints
items.body: Usually from yard or parkway trees planted with the subdivision.
A pipe that's fine but needs cleaning.

items.h3: Clay and Cast Iron in Older Homes
items.body: Cracks, offsets and root mats in homes built before the 1970s.

blocks.h2: How a Camera Inspection Works With Us

steps.body: The depth and position of every problem marked.
What matters, what can wait and a copy of the video.

blocks.h2: Sewer Camera Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Should I get a sewer inspection before buying a home in Mokena?
items.preview: Yes, even for a newer home.
items.answer: Yes. Even a home from the 2000s can have a sag or a root problem. A camera look before you close can turn up a repair worth negotiating.

items.q: Can the camera tell where the problem is?
items.answer: Yes. The camera head carries a transmitter, and our locator marks the spot and the depth from the surface.

items.q: Do I get a copy of the video?
items.answer: Yes. You keep the recording, which helps with repair quotes, a home sale or an insurance claim.

items.q: Is a camera inspection worth it if the drains work fine?
items.answer: If you're buying, finishing the basement or have big trees near the line, yes. Otherwise there's no need to inspect a line that's working.

items.q: How much does a sewer camera inspection cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on access and length. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on access and the length of the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
